ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, legal representative, board members and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists, EU/UK consolidated sanctions, domestic Viet Nam sanctions and terrorist lists maintained by the Ministry of Public Security and State Bank of Viet Nam, Interpol notices, and World Bank debarment lists; PEP identification under Article 8 of Law No. 14/2022/QH15 with enhanced due diligence on politically exposed persons, their family members and close associates; ongoing name and transactional screening on a minimum quarterly basis, event-driven re-screening, five-year record retention, and prompt suspicious transaction reporting to Viet Nam's Money Laundering Reporting Center.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Registration Portal of Viet Nam (https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: A legitimate enterprise name in Viet Nam must be written in the Vietnamese alphabet and contain two elements: a legal form element such as 'Công ty TNHH' (LLC) and a proper name expressed using Vietnamese letters, digits, or approved symbols; foreign-language names of foreign investors must be transliterated into Vietnamese-script spelling for the registered name, while a corresponding foreign-language name may be used in parentheses; the name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an already registered enterprise name and must not violate historical, cultural, sovereignty or ethical norms.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Names identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered enterprise in Viet Nam
Words, symbols or abbreviations associated with state agencies, political organizations, armed forces, 'Ministry', 'Government', 'People's Committee', 'Police', 'Army', 'Party'
Terms such as 'Viet Nam', 'national economy', or 'state-owned' in a way suggesting state ownership without competent authority approval
Financial-sector tokens requiring prior license: 'bank', 'insurance', 'securities', 'investment fund', 'pawn shop'

Professional-service tokens requiring occupational license: 'construction', 'health service', 'pharmacy', 'education', 'employment service', 'law firm' unless the corresponding license is actually held
Words violating public order, national sovereignty, historical truth or Vietnamese traditional morality
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Viet Nam operates on name clearance at registration rather than a separate extensible name-reservation product. When an electronic filing is rejected on name grounds, the applicant receives the DPI's stated reason in the online dossier; the enterprise must correct and re-file promptly, generally within 30 days, because the ERC decision is made based on the dossier at hand. If the DPI maintains a rejection, the applicant may lodge a formal administrative complaint under the Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13 with the same DPI within 30 days from the refusal, or address the complaint to the provincial People's Committee for a second-instance review; a further judicial appeal may be filed with the competent Administrative Court under the Law on Administrative Proceedings. Engagement of a local counsel to re-check the name database and submit a legally substantiated appeal is recommended.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is not acceptable as a standalone registered office. The registered address must be a real, physical premises in Viet Nam over which the LLC has a lawful right of use (ownership, lease, or consent of the owner), and the address must be accurately stated in the Enterprise Registration Certificate. A pure PO box, mail-forwarding only address or desk in another company without a lease and business function will be rejected; co-working or serviced-office space is acceptable only if the LLC has a written, physically located lease and the premises can accommodate statutory inspection. Because the scope ISIC 7830/NAICS 561312 executive search can be treated as an employment-service conditional business, DOLISA may additionally require a local business office from which recruitment activity is conducted.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-to-high; approximately 25-35% likelihood of an unannounced on-site inspection during the first 18 months after ERC/licence issuance, with mandatory inspection events at the time of employment-service licence application and renewal; tax authority visits during the first two years are increasingly common for newly licensed service entities in the low-risk classification.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (Articles 24-31, 46, 75-79); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 (Articles 36-38, 65-68); Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on Enterprise Registration (Articles 22-27); Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP detailing the Law on Investment (Articles 22-25, 30-32); Law on Employment No. 10/2012/QH13 (Articles 43-47); Decree No. 23/2021/ND-CP on Employment Service Licensing (Articles 20-25); Circular No. 47/2019/TT-BTC of the Ministry of Finance on registration fees.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Investment Registration Authority and Business Registration Office under the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province or centrally-run city where the head office is located; secondary licensing authority is the Department of Labour, Invalids and Social Affairs (DOLISA) for the employment service operating license.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Issuance of Investment Registration Certificate and Application for Enterprise Registration (Form I-1 to Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP), together with the Company Charter, List of Members and Capital Contribution Schedule.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Viet Nam imposes no statutory minimum paid-up capital for a Limited Liability Company; the charter capital determined by the members must be fully contributed within 90 days from the Enterprise Registration Certificate. For the regulated headhunting activity, an additional security escrow deposit of VND 300,000,000 (approximately USD 12,800) must be placed in and blocked at a licensed commercial bank in the Company's name, maintained for the duration of the employment service license and withdrawable only after re-placement or lawful termination of the license.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FORMAL RESOLUTION NO. 01 OF THE FOUNDING MEMBERS COUNCIL OF [COMPANY NAME] LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY, ADOPTED AT [CITY], VIET NAM ON [DATE]. WHEREAS the Company has been established as a limited liability company under the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14; WHEREAS the Investment Registration Certificate No. [•] has been issued by the Department of Planning and Investment of [Province/City]; WHEREAS the Members Council exercises supreme corporate authority and the founding members present hold not less than 100% of the total subscribed charter capital. NOW THEREFORE IT IS RESOLVED AND UNANIMOUSLY ADOPTED: 1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION: The charter capital of the Company is fixed at VND [•] (in words), and each founding member subscribes to the capital amounts set out in the List of Members attached to the Charter. The subscribed capital shall be fully paid in cash or lawful assets within 90 days of the Enterprise Registration Certificate. The General Director is instructed to open the capital contribution account, maintain contribution records and complete all registrations with the Business Registration Office. 2. REGISTERED OFFICE: The registered office and principal place of business of the Company is adopted at [full address]. The General Director is authorised to execute and sign the office lease, deliver the lease to the licensing authorities and register any subsequent change of registered office with the DPI. 3. CORORATE GOVERNANCE: The Company Charter and internal corporate governance rules are adopted; the corporate seal shall be procured, its specimen registered on the National Business Registration Portal and the Company shall publish registration information within 30 days as prescribed by law. 4. OFFICER APPOINTMENTS: [Name] is appointed Chairman of the Members Council; [Name] is appointed General Director and Chief Executive Officer; [Name] is appointed Legal Representative of the Company in accordance with Article 46 of the Law on Enterprises and is vested with full authority to open bank accounts, execute laboratory, licensing, tax, social insurance and administrative documents, represent the Company before courts and State authorities, and exercise day-to-day management within the scope of the Charter. In the event of absence, [Name] is appointed as authorised officer to act as substitute legal representative. 5. LICENSING ACTIONS: The General Director is directed to apply to DOLISA for the License to Operate Employment Services, to place the mandatory security deposit of VND 300,000,000 with a licensed bank, and to procure fire safety and occupational safety approvals for the office premises before operations commence. 6. POWER OF ATTORNEY: The Chairman and the Legal Representative are jointly and severally authorised to sign and submit all documents, receive the Enterprise Registration Certificate and Investment Registration Certificate and represent the Company in all incorporation proceedings. This Resolution is effective upon adoption and remains valid until revoked. Certified as a true copy: Chairman of the Members Council: [Signature] | Legal Representative: [Signature].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) for 100% Foreign-Owned LLC Engaging in Executive Search and Headhunting Services
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Registration Authority, Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province or centrally-run city of the registered office; special cases requiring investment policy approval by the Prime Minister or the Ministry of Planning and Investment are not applicable to a standard low-threshold service project.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the prescribed application dossier through the National Business Registration Portal or in person at the DPI's One-Stop Administrative Service Center. The dossier must be in Vietnamese; foreign corporate documents must be translated into Vietnamese, notarized in Viet Nam, and consular legalized at the Vietnamese Embassy or Consulate in the issuing country because Viet Nam has not acceded to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention, unless a bilateral legalization-exemption treaty applies. Verified financial capacity may be evidenced by audited parent company financial statements, a certified bank confirmation of the investment amount, or a parent company guarantee. The project description must expressly state the executive search, C-level placement and specialist technology headhunting services, the headcount, proposed staffing and intended office location. The DPI must process a complete valid dossier within 15 working days. An IRC will be issued on the electronic system and in hard copy, recording the charter capital, owners, investment objectives and market-access conditions applicable to the employment services sector.
required_dossiers: Application for issuance of the Investment Registration Certificate (form prescribed under Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP) signed by the authorized representative
Certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing of each foreign founding company, translated into Vietnamese, notarized and consular legalized
Audited financial statements or bank guarantee/letter of credit confirming financial capacity
Project proposal describing the executive search and specialist technology headhunting business, office headcount and revenue plan
Lease agreement, letter of intent for office location, or title document of the proposed head-office premises
Passport or ID copies of authorized representatives and members, with notarization
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI issues a written notice of invalid or supplementary dossier, the investor must cure the defects and resubmit within 30 days. If the application is refused, the investor may file a complaint with the Chairman of the provincial People's Committee under the Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13, or initiate administrative court proceedings under the Law on Administrative Procedures No. 93/2015/QH13 within the statutory limitation period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Apply for Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) of the Limited Liability Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Office, Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province or centrally-run city, acting on the national enterprise registration database.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the IRC, submit the application for enterprise registration to the DPI Business Registration Office, either electronically through the National Business Registration Portal or at the provincial One-Stop Center. Provide the Company Charter executed by all founding members, the list of members, legal representative consent and identity documents, capital contribution schedule, and a copy of the IRC. Notarization of Vietnamese signatures and identity documents is required; the DPI may not require notarization for documents filed electronically if verified senior officials sign with authentication certificates. The DPI shall issue the Enterprise Registration Certificate within 3 working days of receipt of a complete dossier. The Company's tax code is unconditionally granted simultaneously with the ERC article in the national database.
required_dossiers: Application for Enterprise Registration (Form I-1 under Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP)
Company Charter signed by all founding members
List of Members and capital contribution schedule
Notarized identity documents of the Legal Representative and members
Copy of the Investment Registration Certificate and investment registration code
Consular legalized and notarized incorporation documents of foreign members (already available from Step 1)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI returns the dossier with a notice of incompleteness, supply the requested documents within the time limit stated in the notice. If the ERC is refused or delayed beyond 3 working days, file a complaint with the DPI Director, then appeal to the Chairman of the provincial People's Committee or the Ministry of Planning and Investment, or institute administrative proceedings before the Administrative Court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Seal Engraving, Seal Specimen Registration and Mandatory Company Announcement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Office, Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) through the National Business Registration Portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the ERC is issued, the Company may obtain a corporate seal from any licensed engraving facility. Enter the seal details and upload the seal specimen image into the National Business Registration Portal within 30 days from the date of public announcement. The Company must also publish basic registration facts (enterprise name, charter capital, address, legal representative) on the portal. Submit Form I-8 with a certified copy of the seal specimen and identification of the keeper of the seal if the DPI requests a physical filing. The seal must be kept at the head office under the responsibility of the Legal Representative. No prior State approval of the seal is required.
required_dossiers: Copy of the Enterprise Registration Certificate so the portal confirms the enterprise code
Corporate seal specimen in .jpg or .pdf at 300 dpi
Resolution of the Members Council adopting the seal control rules and designating the seal custodian
Simultaneous portal submission of the public notice of registered enterprise information
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the portal upload is queried due to an illegible specimen or format error, re-upload the corrected specimen immediately. If the portal announcement fails, the DPI will issue an electronic or paper notice identifying the defect, which must be rectified within 10 days to avoid administrative sanctions under Decree No. 122/2021/ND-CP.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain License to Operate Employment Services from DOLISA
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Labour, Invalids and Social Affairs (DOLISA) of the province or centrally-run city where the head office is located.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a written application for the License to Operate Employment Services (Giấy phép hoạt động dịch vụ việc làm) together with the ERC, IRC, certificate of the VND 300,000,000 blocked bank deposit, proof of lawful office premises, and documentation of the Directors and professional senior consultants demonstrating qualifications for executive search. DOLISA reviews the complete dossier and issues the operating license, or issues a written refusal setting out grounds, within 20 working days of receiving a valid application. The license, when issued, permits job introduction and placement services including C-suite executive search and specialist technology headhunting; separate authorization is required for overseas worker dispatch under Decree No. 127/2021/ND-CP if that activity is later added.
required_dossiers: Application for the License to Operate Employment Services in the form under Decree No. 23/2021/ND-CP
Certified copies of the Enterprise Registration Certificate and Investment Registration Certificate
Certificate from a licensed commercial bank evidencing the blocked security deposit of VND 300,000,000 in the Company's name
Proof of lawful use of the office premises, including lease contract and certificate of the building use rights
Curriculum vitae, employment contracts and professional certificates of the legal representative and service-operating personnel evidencing capacity in recruitment and executive search
Judicial records certificates of the legal representative and principal officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DOLISA refuses or requires amendment, the Company may cure any factual defect and resubmit a new application with the deficiency removed. Within 30 days of a refusal, the Company may lodge a complaint with the Chairman of the provincial People's Committee, and successively appeal to the Ministry of Labour, Invalids and Social Affairs, or commence proceedings before the Administrative Court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, Bank Account Opening, Labor Contract Registration and Social Insurance Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Tax Branch (Sub-Department of Taxation), Social Security agency of the province, and the statistics/ labor inspectorate of DOLISA.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Activate the tax file that was auto-created with the ERC; register value-added tax declaration status, invoice templates and tax payment methods with the local tax office; notify the tax authority and DOLISA of all bank accounts opened by the Company; open a USD and VND account for remittance of client retainers through wire or Wise B2B rails. Register an internal labor regulation and employment contracts with the provincial labor authority when the Company has 10 or more employees; submit the first social insurance, health insurance and unemployment insurance declaration to the Social Security agency within 30 days of the first hire. The Company must file tax returns (monthly/quarterly VAT and Corporate Income Tax provisional declarations) beginning from the month of ERC issuance, regardless of revenue generation.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate and tax code
Business license of the payroll office or branch, if salary processing is local
Draft internal labor regulations and the labor rule filing form
Labor contracts of Directors and employees on the Vietnamese standard template
Social insurance registration forms, employee lists, salaries and bank account confirmation
Lease agreement evidence for the head-office location for tax authority verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax office issues an administrative fine or demand for late filing, correct the filing immediately and submit a mitigating explanation; interest and late payment penalties accrue under Law No. 71/2014/QH13 on Tax Administration. If social insurance registration is incomplete, the Company may register late with the Social Security agency, curing by submission of employee contribution schedules and payment of outstanding monthly contributions plus late interest.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tong Cuc Thue) under the Ministry of Finance of Viet Nam; official e-filing portal: https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn; national e-invoice portal: https://hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn; integrated business registration portal: https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-invested Limited Liability Company automatically obtains a single statutory tax identification number (Ma So Thue, 'MST', 13-digit format) through the one-stop enterprise registration procedure at the provincial Department of Planning and Investment. The Certificate of Enterprise Registration functions as the tax registration certificate, with the MST simultaneously valid for CIT, VAT, personal income tax withholding, and social insurance contributions. Non-resident foreign contractors without a Vietnamese permanent establishment must register separately under the Foreign Contractor Tax regime using Form 01/GTGT (deduction method) or the direct/hybrid method forms at the local tax office where the Vietnamese paying entity is located.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Viet Nam has no check-the-box pass-through election and no general hybrid-mismatch election. A resident Vietnamese LLC is mandatorily taxed at entity level on worldwide income under the Corporate Income Tax Law 14/2008/QH12 and confirming Law 32/2013/QH13. Available statutory elections include: (i) selection among the three Foreign Contractor Tax computation methods (deduction, direct, hybrid); (ii) election to apply preferential CIT regimes (10% for 15 years, tax holidays, or reduced tax on the first four profitable years) for qualifying new high-technology or large-scale investment projects; and (iii) election by SMEs to pay land-use related taxes under alternative accounting bases. Any arrangement structured to exploit divergent tax classification between jurisdictions remains subject to the general anti-avoidance rule and substance-over-form review under Article 32 of Law 38/2019/QH14 on Tax Administration.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) — Thue Gia Tri Gia Tang (GTGT)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VND 1,000,000,000 (one billion Vietnamese Dong) of annual revenue from taxable supplies is the compulsory VAT registration threshold for household and individual businesses; incorporated enterprises, including LLCs, are automatically VAT-registered upon obtaining their MST regardless of revenue level, with mandatory e-invoicing applicable from constitution.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing applies in full force from 1 July 2022 under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC. Every VAT invoice must be issued as a structured XML file signed with a digital signature and transmitted to the General Department of Taxation portal immediately upon issuance; sales in certain high-risk sectors must obtain a pre-generated tax authority invoice code (Ma Cua Co Quan Thue) embedded in the invoice before the document is delivered to the customer. There is no per-transaction real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping requirement for standard executive-search supplies; instead a batch transmission protocol applies. For retained executive-search services retained on an international export basis, the LLC must maintain the 0% tax schedule e-invoice alongside the customs-free service export evidence.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Executive search and headhunting services qualify for the 0% VAT export rate under Article 9 of Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC where: (i) the service is supplied to a foreign organization or individual under a written service contract; (ii) the service is consumed entirely outside Viet Nam; (iii) the foreign client has no permanent establishment in Viet Nam to which the service is attributable; and (iv) payment is remitted to the Vietnamese LLC in foreign currency through a licensed bank evidenced by an inward remittance certificate. Placement fees, retainer fees pre-paid by offshore clients, and success fees receivable from foreign clients for identifying C-suite talent outside Viet Nam are zero-rated; concurrent services rendered to the Vietnamese branch or subsidiary of an overseas client remain subject to 10% VAT.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (To Khai Hai Quan Dien Tu) where goods are exported in connection with the supply (not typical for pure executive search)
Bill of Lading (B/L) or Airway Bill (AWB) evidencing cross-border movement, where applicable
Signed executive search service contract or engagement letter in Vietnamese and English between the VN_LLC and the overseas client
0% VAT electronic invoice (XML format) transmitted to the GDT portal
Bank Inward Remittance Certificate (Xac Nhan Thu Tien Chuyen Nam) or SWIFT MT103 evidencing receipt of foreign currency from the offshore client
Foreign client evidence of non-resident status (halal) such as corporate registration certificate, tax domicile certificate, or VAT/company-code extract of the overseas jurisdiction
Service delivery report / placement memorandum documenting that the service was consumed outside Viet Nam
KYC and AML standard onboarding records of the foreign client (low-risk standard privacy-tier for executive search)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The General Department of Taxation exercises heightened audit scrutiny over export-oriented zero-rating claims. A retroactive assessment period of up to 10 years applies to fraudulently claimed VAT refunds under Article 12 of Law 38/2019/QH14. On an adverse finding, the tax authority will claw back every input VAT credit previously refunded, plus interest calculated at the State Bank refinancing rate, and impose administrative fines equal to one to three times the evaded tax amount under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP. Repeated or aggravated falsification of export documentation further exposes legal representatives to criminal liability under Article 200 of the Penal Code 2015 (as amended) with imprisonment terms of up to 20 years, loss of e-invoice usage status, and permanent suspension from the e-invoice refund system. The LLC must therefore maintain immutable archive records for each zero-rated retainer, including end-to-end retained evidence of offshore consumption and foreign-currency realization.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) (Ngân hàng Nhà nước Việt Nam), acting through the Foreign Exchange Management Department, the Banking Supervision and Inspection Agency, and provincial branches; foreign exchange and payment-system regulations are issued under the Law on the State Bank of Vietnam 2010, the Ordinance on Foreign Exchange 2005 (as amended by Ordinance No. 06/2013/UBTVQH13), Decree No. 70/2014/ND-CP, Decree No. 15/2018/ND-CP, Circular No. 28/2016/TT-NHNN, Circular No. 05/2021/TT-NHNN, and Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN. The SBV exclusively licenses foreign exchange activity and cross-border payment intermediation, while the Ministry of Planning and Investment (MPI) and provincial Departments of Planning and Investment (DPIs) retain authority over the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) that underpins capital-account flows for the foreign-invested LLC.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: VND is not freely convertible offshore. Current-account transactions are largely convertible: foreign-invested enterprises may buy and sell foreign currency at licensed banks for trade and service payments without separate SBV approval, subject to underlying documentation. Capital-account transactions are controlled: charter capital injection, capital increases, shareholder loans, equity transfers, and liquidation/profit remittance require the registered IRC/ERC, an SBV-licensed direct-investment capital account, and prior registration or approval where required. Profit remittance to the non-resident shareholder is permitted annually following the completion of audited financial statements, CIT finalization, and filing of the post-audit profit remittance form (under Circular No. 186/2010/TT-BTC); the enterprise must prove the accumulated statutory reserve has been constituted, all tax obligations are settled, and there are no outstanding tax liabilities confirmed by the tax officer. VND convertibility for speculative or working-capital purposes unrelated to underlying commercial transactions is not permitted; all FX payments must be matched to genuine trade, investment, or loan exposure. The side effects for an executive-search LLC are that retainer invoices to foreign clients create service-export receivables collected in USD/EUR, which must either be held in a foreign-currency account or converted to VND, but the enterprise cannot freely transfer VND offshore to fund overseas group operations without an underlying permitted transaction.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Article 12 of Decree No. 70/2014/ND-CP as amended by Decree No. 15/2018/ND-CP, export proceeds received in foreign currency must be repatriated into Vietnam through a licensed bank within 90 calendar days from the date of service completion (for services) or customs clearance (for goods). There is no statutory mandatory conversion ratio: the LLC may retain repatriated export proceeds in its foreign-currency account at a licensed bank and is permitted to sell them to the bank at market rates, but conversion outside licensed banks is prohibited. For ISIC 7830 executive search, each inbound retainer from a non-resident client is a service export; the underlying mandate letter, signed retainer agreement, placement invoice, delivery evidence, and bank SWIFT credit advice must be date-stamped and archived to demonstrate compliance with the 90-day repatriation window. Late repatriation or failure to repatriate is an administrative violation penalized under Decree No. 88/2019/ND-CP as amended by Decree No. 143/2021/ND-CP with fines up to VND 100,000,000 and, for repeat or material non-compliance, suspension of foreign-currency accounts and adverse SBV inspection findings. The rule does not apply to lawfully retained balances required to pay approved foreign debts or amounts exempted in writing by the SBV.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: CONDITIONAL with LOW reliance for primary clearing. Wise (Wise Asia-Pacific Pte. Ltd. and its local partner arrangements), Revolut Business, Airwallex, and similar offshore digital EMIs are not licensed by the SBV as credit institutions or intermediate payment service providers and therefore cannot lawfully open VND-denominated accounts or independently settle payments into the domestic payment system. For the VN_LLC executive-search treasury, Wise B2B is viable only as an ancillary collection rail for small inbound retainer wires from Western clients where the client lacks SWIFT capabilities; funds must be routed to the licensee with an underlying service contract, and the collected foreign currency must be repatriated to the LLC's SBV-licensed VND or foreign-currency account within the 90-day window. Outbound uses of Wise for vendor or payroll payments from within Vietnam are not viable because the SBV requires cross-border outbound payment orders to be executed by licensed banks after know-your-transaction screening; a non-licensed EMI cannot provide the locally admissible FX invoice evidence and would create an unlawful channel. Airwallex is rated Medium for collection convenience but remains legally constrained to bank-partner rails. Legal risks include: operating an unauthorized payment service (administrative penalties under Decree 88/2019/ND-CP), inability to satisfy Vietnamese tax e-invoice mapping, and SBV foreign-currency control violations. Therefore the treasury design places Wise B2B strictly in a vendor-collection overflow layer, never as the statutory capital, tax payment, or primary payroll rail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance is mandatory for the LLC's legal representative (Chairman or General Director) and for each authorized signatory at the chosen bank branch. Remote video-KYC is not accepted by major Vietnamese banks for first-time corporate onboarding of a 100-percent foreign-invested entity; the foreign director must be physically present in Vietnam with the original passport, the legalized and certified Vietnamese translation of the passport, the IRC, the ERC, the company seal registration certificate, the Members' Council resolution approving account opening and signatory mandates, and specimen signatures. If the foreign director is unable to travel, a lawfully executed power of attorney must be notarized and legalized in the home jurisdiction, then translated and certified in Vietnam, appointing a resident Vietnamese individual who will appear in person; however, banks generally require the foreign beneficial owner to attend an initial interview within the first 90 days and some branch-level compliance units (notably at Vietcombank and BIDV) will refuse to activate e-banking higher limits until the BO interview is completed. Allow four to six calendar weeks for the full onboarding sequence: consular/legalization process, translation, branch AML review, capital-account registration with the SBV, and activation of the direct-investment capital account. A practical mitigation is to open the operational VND account at the same bank in parallel and to retain a licensed corporate secretary or law firm in Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City to manage branch-level KYC appointments.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear beneficial ownership created by a multi-tiered foreign parent chain, nominee shareholders, or trusts above the VN LLC.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A complete chain-of-ownership chart from the VN LLC through each intermediate entity to the ultimate natural persons controlling more than 10 percent of shares; certified share registers; the IRC and ERC; formation documents and certificates of incumbency from each upstream jurisdiction; passport copies or Legal Entity Identifiers for all UBOs; sworn declarations disclaiming nominee arrangements; and independent corporate registry searches dated within 30 days prior to onboarding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-funds opacity for the initial charter capital injection, particularly any single remittance above USD 50,000 from a private or mixed-source account.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six months of bank statements from the remitting party evidencing genuine accumulation; the signed shareholders' subscription resolution; the share transfer or loan agreement if funds derive from intra-group financing; the parent company's audited financial statements; source-of-wealth reports for individual investors; tax payment receipts in the remitting jurisdiction; and a signed source-of-funds declaration referencing the Law on Prevention and Control of Money Laundering as amended in 2022 and Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or PEP screening flags triggered by an overseas client, candidate, or beneficial owner in the executive-search fee flow.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed screening output from an internationally recognized sanctions/negative-media tool; official passport or entity registration evidence; a written explanation of any flagged names; a negative news-media review printout; the underlying signed retainer/mandate proving the transaction is a legitimate headhunting service; and a documented de-risking decision if the counterparty is in a comprehensively sanctioned jurisdiction, including refusal or exit-customer procedures under the bank's AML policy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction nexus because client payments originate from tax havens or jurisdictions with weak AML frameworks, triggering enhanced due diligence (EDD).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: An EDD file compiled by an external compliance officer containing the commercial executive-search contract, the headhunting mandate letter, candidate CV deliverables, timesheets, itemized invoices, corporate registry evidence of the client, and a structured business-rationale memo explaining why the client selects a low-tax jurisdiction; the file must be pre-cleared before the wire and made available to the bank's transaction monitoring unit.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transaction-pattern mismatch between the registered business scope (ISIC 7830 executive search) and observed flows such as recurring inbound retainer income from abroad or outbound payments to overseas candidate bank accounts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Copy of the statutory employment-services license or the lawful exercise of unlicensed executive-search activity under the Enterprise Law 2020 and Decree No. 27/2020/ND-CP; the registered ISIC/NACE scope in the ERC; three executed retainer agreements with payment schedules; candidate placement reports and placement confirmations; a fee-quantum justification memo comparing fees to the applicable percentage of placed executive compensation (typically 20 to 33 percent of total annual salary); and the tax e-invoices issued for each settlement.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The VN LLC must open a direct investment capital account (a foreign-currency capital account) at an SBV-licensed bank before receiving charter capital. The process: submit the IRC, ERC, and the shareholders' resolution on capital contribution to the chosen bank; the bank registers the capital account and may require SBV confirmation where the contribution schedule is phased. Each inbound wire must be executed via SWIFT MT103 from the investor's overseas account with the purpose narrative clearly stating that it is a contribution to charter capital, citing the IRC number, ERC number and the legal entity name; use of the investment purpose code corresponding to foreign direct investment as required by the bank's reporting code list. The full subscribed capital must be contributed within 90 days from the certificate of enterprise registration per Article 47 of the Enterprise Law 2020; failure to contribute the remaining amount by the deadline renders the un-contributed portion non-transferable and is sanctionable under Decree No. 50/2021/ND-CP with fines from VND 20,000,000 to VND 30,000,000, and the bank will not credit late funds as lawful share capital. The bank issues the capital contribution confirmation (Giấy xác nhận góp vốn) used for the updated IRC and for later profit remittance verification. The LLC must never allow charter capital to be received into a personal account or an ordinary operating account; such inflows are classified as unidentifiable and may be refused or reported as suspicious. For subsequent capital increases, the capital account operating limit must first be increased by a DPI-approved adjusted IRC before the next MT103; for share transfers, the purchase price must be routed through the capital account after the DPI registers the transfer, with a Foreign Exchange Registration Letter to the SBV. For the executive-search LLC, the charter capital can be as low as VND 100,000 market-rate equivalent because no minimum capital applies to headhunting services, but the bank may impose a practical minimum commensurate with first-year payroll and the proposed physical office.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The service-export treasury of the LLC will generate outbound flows for: overseas subcontractors and background verification vendors; candidate relocation payments; software and job-board subscriptions; payroll to expatriates; management fees to the foreign parent; and annual profit remittance to shareholders. All outbound disbursements must be executed through the licensed Vietnamese bank using SWIFT MT103 for standard vendor invoices below USD 100,000; Commercial Letters of Credit (documentary credit) are appropriate only where the transaction has a goods or equipment component, which is not typical for executive search, so the primary rails are bank e-banking transfers with full underlying documentation. Every wire must be tagged with the SBV statistical purpose code set under Circular No. 05/2021/TT-NHNN; relevant codes include code 16 for professional, management and consulting services, code 22 for other business services, code 09 for remittance of profits and dividends, and code 02 for royalties and license fees. The LLC must apply Foreign Contractor Tax withholding (1 percent VAT plus 5 percent CIT on gross consideration, unless a reduced rate or exemption sits in the applicable Double Tax Agreement) when paying non-resident service providers, and must obtain the foreign vendor's tax identification number or residence certificate where DTA relief is claimed; the payment file must combine the commercial contract, foreign invoice, FCT declaration, and proof of filing with the tax office. Wires from USD 50,000 and above will be detained by the bank's transaction monitoring unit until the full set is produced; therefore, the treasury should schedule vendor payments weekly and pre-upload supporting PDFs to the e-banking portal. Management fees to the offshore parent must satisfy the arm's length condition and be included in the country-by-country transfer pricing documentation; undocumented management fees are frequently reclassified as dividends, triggering withholding tax and penalties. Profit remittance follows the post-audit procedure: audited annual financial statements, tax finalization, constitution of statutory reserves, submission of the profit-remittance declaration, and a single MT103 to the shareholder account after the bank's legal review.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable VND/USD and VND/EUR currency forwards for a tenor of up to 365 days, executed with an SBV-licensed bank under Circular No. 28/2016/TT-NHNN as amended by Circular No. 15/2023/TT-NHNN, subject to a genuine and documented underlying trade, service, investment or loan exposure; non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not an authorized onshore hedging instrument for Vietnamese corporate clients.

VND/USD and VND/EUR currency swaps permitted under the same SBV circular framework, enabling conversion of a retained foreign-currency receivable into VND while preserving future conversion rights, provided the notional does not exceed the verified underlying receivables or payables.

FX options (put and call structures on VND against USD/EUR) offered by licensed banks as over-the-counter contracts, only with a partially or fully drawn underlying transaction and with option premium and strike values recorded in the bank's derivatives ledger; the exercise must be settled on a deliverable basis.

Cross-currency interest-rate swaps for medium-term offshore shareholder loans that have been properly registered with the SBV under Circular No. 12/2022/TT-NHNN, enabling the LLC to swap foreign-currency debt service into VND cash-flow exposure while remaining within the registered facility ceiling.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements (Bao cao tai chinh nam) submitted through the National Enterprise Registration Portal and direct filing to the managing tax office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the registration province and the local Tax Office under the General Department of Taxation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days from the fiscal year end; for calendar-year taxpayers on or before 31 March of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing attracts graduated fines of VND 2,000,000 to 25,000,000 (approx. USD 80 to 1,000) under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP; chronic non-filing triggers tax enforcement action, public blacklisting, and eventual administrative strike-off by DPI.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Finalization Return (To khai quyet toan thue TNDN) and annual tax finalization dossier
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Tax Office (Chi cuc Thue / Cuc Thue) where the LLC is registered for tax administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March following the fiscal year (90 days after fiscal year end); quarterly estimated CIT payments are due by the 30th day of the month following each quarter
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment interest at 0.03% per day on arrears; late-filing fines up to VND 25,000,000 (approx. USD 1,000); under-declaration penalties up to 20% of the deficient tax plus interest; tax evasion may trigger 1.0 to 3.0 times the evaded amount and criminal referral.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business License Fee (Le phi mon bai) declaration and payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Tax Office responsible for license fee collection
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 January of each annual cycle; newly established enterprises are exempt for the establishment year and first pay from the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Daily late payment interest at 0.03% per day plus administrative fines for late filing and non-payment under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP; the fee ranges from VND 2,000,000 (approx. USD 80) for charter capital up to VND 10 billion to VND 3,000,000 (approx. USD 120) above that threshold.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual employment services activity report (Bao cao hoat dong dich vu viec lam) for licensed executive search and headhunting operations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Labour, Invalids and Social Affairs (DOLISA) of the province where the Employment Services License is held
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual report within 15 days after the end of the calendar year (by 15 January of the following year); semi-annual report by 15 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative monetary penalties for non-reporting under Decree 12/2022/ND-CP; repeated non-compliance can lead to suspension or revocation of the Employment Services License; no separate statutory renewal fee applies.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Periodic labor utilization reports (Bao cao tinh hinh su dung lao dong) covering staffing changes and headcount
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Labour, Invalids and Social Affairs (DOLISA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Semi-annual report due by 5 June and annual report due by 5 December of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines up to VND 10,000,000 (approx. USD 400) for failure to submit periodic labor reports under Decree 12/2022/ND-CP.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit applies to public companies, securities companies, fund management companies, credit institutions, insurance enterprises, and enterprises with State ownership of 20% or more. In addition, Vietnamese compliance practice requires foreign-invested limited liability companies to submit independently audited financial statements to the provincial DPI and tax authority as part of annual filing; otherwise there is no revenue-based statutory audit threshold for a private LLC.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) and the enterprise accounting regime under Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC govern statutory standalone financial statements; IFRS is permitted on a voluntary pilot basis for consolidated financial statements of large parent groups under Decision 345/2020/QD-TTg.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No annual UBO declaration or UBO register filing is required for a Vietnamese LLC. Ownership is evidenced by the statutory Register of Members maintained at the head office, and any share transfer must be recorded in that register and notified to DPI within 10 days of the change. Foreign investors changing shareholding must complete post-registration updates with DPI, and the Anti-Money Laundering Law 2022 requires customer due diligence and UBO identification at transaction level, but no annual confirmation filing.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (So dang ky thanh vien) maintained at the head office and reflecting current ownership
Register and records of legal representatives and management with appointment and resignation resolutions
Minute Book and resolution archive of the Members Council and legal representative decisions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300 to 900 per year for registered address and administrative agent support in Ho Chi Minh City or Hanoi
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,200 to 5,000 per year for a small or medium executive search LLC engaged through a local licensed audit firm
